nodes.description: Primary proxy storage struct holding accounts, epochs, balance and provider state.
EIP-16 storage extension mapping coupon underlying balances per account/epoch.
EIP-18 storage extension holding era status and era start.
EIP-1967 implementation address storage slot used by the proxy.
Implementation initializer that mints incentives/dev rewards and resets debt; protected by initializer modifier.
External epoch advancement function that incentivizes the caller and runs Bonding/Market step functions.
External function allowing an account to buy coupons by burning dollar debt.
External function redeeming coupon underlying after two epochs and minting dollars to the caller.
External migration function converting legacy coupons into coupon underlying at half value.
External coupon transfer with optional allowance deduction when msg.sender is a spender.
External coupon allowance approval setting spender allowance for msg.sender.
External governance voting function that nominates candidates and locks stake.
External function executing an approved governance proposal via implementation upgrade.
External emergency governance commit requiring super majority approval.
Internal proxy upgrade performing delegatecall to new implementation's initialize().
Private function writing the new implementation address to the EIP-1967 slot via assembly sstore.
External function transferring dollars from an account into staged balance.
External function transferring staged dollars back to the caller.
External function bonding staged dollars into ESDS shares.
External function converting ESDS shares back into staged dollars.
External function unbonding a stated underlying dollar value.
Bonding.step snapshotting bonded supply and incrementing the epoch.
Market.step expiring prior coupons and scheduling current epoch expiration.
Private function minting the advance incentive to an account.
Internal function minting dollars to an account then performing balance check.
Internal function pulling dollars from an account, burning them and decrementing debt.
Private invariant check requiring contract dollar balance to cover bonded, staged and redeemable.
Internal function minting redeemed dollars and optional coupon payouts to an account.
Untrusted caller address (msg.sender) controlling external entry points.
Untrusted block timestamp (block.timestamp) used for epoch timing.
External call dollar().mint minting new ESD tokens.
External calls dollar().transfer/transferFrom moving ESD tokens.
External call dollar().burn destroying ESD tokens.
Delegatecall into a governance-selected implementation address during upgrade.
Inline assembly sstore writing the proxy implementation slot.
Caller-supplied amount of dollars used to purchase coupons.
Caller-supplied coupon epoch used when redeeming coupons.
Local current epoch captured during coupon purchase.
Caller-supplied staged value to bond.
Local computed ESDS share balance minted by bond.
Caller-supplied candidate address voted on in governance.
Caller-supplied dollar value to deposit.
Local staged dollar amount computed when unbonding shares.

edges.reason: initialize mints incentive and dev rewards keyed to the caller-derived account.
advance uses msg.sender as the incentivized account.
advance emits block.timestamp and epoch timing depends on block.timestamp.
purchaseCoupons credits coupons and burns debt using msg.sender.
redeemCoupons mints redeemed dollars to msg.sender.
migrateCoupons reads and modifies coupon balances for msg.sender.
transferCoupons conditionally deducts allowance based on msg.sender spender identity.
approveCoupons sets allowance owned by msg.sender.
vote records bonded stake of msg.sender and locks the account.
commit emits the caller as committer after governance checks.
emergencyCommit emits the caller as committer after super majority checks.
deposit pulls dollars from msg.sender into staged balance.
withdraw sends staged dollars to msg.sender.
bond credits shares to msg.sender and unfreezes them.
unbond computes staged value from msg.sender balances.
unbondUnderlying debits msg.sender balance for the given value.
amount parameter drives debt burn and coupon amount in purchaseCoupons.
couponEpoch parameter selects which underlying balance is decremented on redeem.
value parameter is bonded into share balance.
candidate parameter selects the nomination target for the vote.
value parameter determines the deposited staged amount.
local epoch is the key under which purchased coupons are stored.
local balance is the computed share amount credited by bond.
local staged is the dollar amount credited back during unbond.
advance calls Bonding.step to snapshot supply and increment epoch.
advance calls Market.step to expire and schedule coupons.
advance calls incentivize to reward the caller.
incentivize mints the advance incentive through mintToAccount.
purchaseCoupons burns the paid dollars via burnFromAccount.
redeemCoupons mints redeemed dollars through redeemToAccount.
mintToAccount runs the balance invariant check after minting.
burnFromAccount runs the balance invariant check after burning.
commit triggers a proxy implementation upgrade after governance approval.
emergencyCommit triggers a proxy implementation upgrade after super majority approval.
upgradeTo first records the new implementation via setImplementation.
mintToAccount performs an external dollar().mint token call.
burnFromAccount performs an external dollar().transferFrom token call.
burnFromAccount performs an external dollar().burn token call.
upgradeTo delegatecalls into a governance-selected implementation that runs initialize().
setImplementation writes the implementation address using inline assembly sstore.

normalization_plan.reason: The purchase amount parameter only feeds purchaseCoupons coupon and debt logic, so it normalizes into that core function.
The couponEpoch parameter is only consumed by redeemCoupons underlying balance accounting.
The local epoch variable is purely an internal key inside purchaseCoupons.
The bond value parameter is only used to mint shares inside bond.
The local balance variable holds the share amount computed solely within bond.
The candidate parameter selects the nomination target only inside vote.
The deposit value parameter determines only the staged amount inside deposit.
The local staged variable holds the dollar amount computed solely within unbond.
